senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. צהר, זהר) [to be bright, to glitter,]
to be clean, pure, esp. to be levitically clean; to be unsusceptible of levitical uncleanness.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Negaim 10:8">Neg. X, 8</cite> <he>שט׳ שעה אחת</he> which has been declared clean once.
<cite ref="Mishnah Mikvaot 2:2">Mikv. II, 2</cite> <he>עד שיודע שט׳</he> until it is ascertained that it has become clean.
<cite ref="Mishnah Mikvaot 3:2">Ib. III, 2</cite> <he>ויִטְהֲרוּ העליונים מן וכ׳</he> so that the waters coming from above become cleansed from the impurity of the lower waters.
<cite ref="Mishnah Negaim 7:4">Neg. VII, 4</cite> <he>ויִטְהַר ממנו</he> and is declared clean from it (the last scall); a. fr.

senses.gloss: to purify, make (levitically) clean; to absolve from sin.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Yoma 8:9">Yoma VIII, 9</cite> <he>מי מְטַהֵר וכ׳</he> who is it that absolves you? <cite ref="Mishnah Yoma 8:9">Ib.</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Jeremiah 17:13">Jer. XVII, 13</cite>) <he>מה מקוה מט׳ וכ׳</he> as the ritual bath (v. <cite ref="M02388"><he>מִקְוֶה</he></cite>) cleanses the unclean, so does the Lord &c.; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to keep clean, guard against contact with unclean things.
units: <cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 16b:8-9">R. Hash. 16ᵇ</cite> <he>חייב … לטַהֵר את עצמו וכ׳</he> one is bound to keep one’s self clean for the festive days.

senses.gloss: to declare טָהוֹר, to decide in favor of cleanness.
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 17a:22">Snh. 17ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>מי שיודע לטַ׳ וכ׳</he> one who knows how to prove a creeping thing to be clean.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 17a:22">Ib.</cite> <he>אני אדון ואֲטַהֲרֶנוּ</he> I will argue and prove it to be clean.
Eduy. VIII, 7 לטמא ולטַ׳ to decide on unclean and clean; a. v. fr.—Part. pass. מְטוֹהָר, pl. מְטוֹהָרִים.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 94b:17">Snh. 94ᵇ</cite> <he>מיד ט׳</he> it becomes clean at once.

senses.gloss: to become clean. Tanḥ. Metsora 7 נִטְהֲרָה וכ׳ she became clean on the eighth day. Ib. ונִטְהֶרֶת and becomes clean; a. fr.
to be cleansed, to cleanse one’s self; to amend.
units: <cite ref="Yoma 38b:16">Yoma 38ᵇ</cite> <he>בא לִטָּהֵר מסייעים אותו</he> (Ms. M. 2 <he>להִטָּהֵר</he>) if one is willing to do good, he will be assisted; <cite ref="Shabbat 104a">Sabb. 104ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 935:12">Yalk. Prov. 935</cite> <he>לִיטָּהֵר</he>; a. e.—

<cite ref="Mishnah Yoma 8:9">Yoma VIII, 9</cite> (<cite ref="Yoma 85b:8">85ᵇ</cite>) <he>לפני מי אתם מִיטַּהֲרִים</he> Mish. a. Y. ed. (Bab. ed. <he>מִטַּ׳</he>) before whom do you cleanse yourselves (from sin)?; a. e.
